audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Vex' while all seven win[N] read 'Irelia', and every whys[] plus early/mid/late told the reader Irelia wins the lane. The page is rated HARD 8/10 and sits at 44.69% over 819 games.
audit.why: The full layer already had the correct verdict; the content layer contradicted it on every row and in every paragraph.
audit.corrected: win[0..6] set to Vex with all seven whys, all seven phases[].why, and early/mid/late rewritten to the losing-side verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike stages claimed Irelia kills Vex before her damage matters and that her ultimate 'executes past 40% HP'.
audit.why: Nothing in Shadow Surge's text is an execute — it is a 2000/2500/3000-range mark-and-dash on 140/120/100. The 40% number had no source.
audit.corrected: All four spikes rewritten to real numbers: 12s Looming Darkness, 16s 475-range Personal Space shield, 140s/100s Shadow Surge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the fear to Personal Space (W). W is a SHIELD. The fear and the dash-interrupt come from Doom 'n Gloom (P), which also marks any nearby enemy who dashes and shortens its own cooldown when that mark is consumed.
audit.why: Riot P text: 'causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark... that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' That is the anti-Irelia mechanic and the page named the wrong ability for it. Defiant Dance is also useless here — Vex is magic damage.
audit.corrected: focus.text, winCon, loading, cooldowns and the dos/donts now name Doom 'n Gloom for the fear and Personal Space for the shield.

audit.why: Looming Darkness flat 12s, Personal Space 16/15/14/13/12, Mistral Bolt 8s to 4s, Shadow Surge 140/120/100.

edits.before: With your first item you kill her before Doom 'n' Gloom stacks meaningful bonus damage, and even late game where her execute ult threatens low-HP targets, you stay ahead by disengaging when she has ult up and diving hard when she doesn't.
edits.after: With your first item you can win a fight she has already spent her pulse and her shield in, but Shadow Surge is 100s at rank 3 and reaches 3000 range, so she opens most fights on her terms — take the ones your team starts, never the ones she does.

notes: The whole page named the wrong ability for Vex's defining mechanic: the fear and dash-interrupt are Doom 'n Gloom (P), not Personal Space (W), which is a 475-range shield. Same class of error as the 'Ares of Blaze' calibration case. report[5].t still carries the old 'Personal Space (Fear)' label — it was not lint-flagged and the report array is capped at two rewrites, so it is left for a follow-up.
